content: 1. Tramadol: Ketoconazole can increase tramadol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This may necessitate dose reduction or adjustment of dosing intervals due to an increased risk of serious adverse events, including seizures and serotonin syndrome. Close monitoring is advised. 2.
